📖 How to use

  1. Enter your pet's name and birthdate.
  2. Choose dog or cat.
  3. Press Calculate.
  4. See exact age and human-equivalent years.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How are human-equivalent years calculated?

Dogs: 15 years for year one, 9 for year two, 5 per year after. Cats: 15 / 9, then 4 per year after. Partial years are prorated monthly.

Does it work for all cat breeds?

Yes — the same 15/9/4 rule used by vets works for all cat breeds.

What exactly does it show?

It shows exact years, months and days of actual age, plus the human-equivalent age.
